sourceText: User asked to proceed with a separate B-991d story for M2 Cell 03 real provider execution, reusing the existing M2 provider execution plan rather than adding a new mega-document. The user also rejected pre-run budget caps as launch gates and wants actual usage/cost calculated after execution.
normalizedOutcome: B-991d documents and gates the real Cell 03 execution path with M0-M9 milestones, B-991d provenance, B-6529 readiness preservation, postflight provider usage accounting, and no unlock of Cell 06, Phase 2, product gates, paper claims, or playbooks.
acceptanceClaim: The existing M2 provider execution plan contains the B-991d Cell 03 real execution ledger and boundaries, and DEV changes do not run provider calls or unlock out-of-scope cells.
